lookup: Source vertices in WGS84 retained within 10-degree clipped tiles; no simplification. Source geometry is a dated ecological model, not survey precision.
modifications: CP1252 decoding; selected attributes; GeoJSON conversion; invalid geometries repaired with Shapely make_valid; clipped gzip lookup tiles; display simplified twice at .035 degrees (second pass removes tiny islands), rounded to four decimals. Includes source Rock and Ice.
